name: whats-next
description: A pane in the side panel listing the next steps of your dev workflow, filled by /ask-sean; click a step to see its prompt.

skill.title: Skill
skill.description: The skill that answers "what's next", named as you would run it (/ask-sean).

maxSteps.title: Most steps
maxSteps.description: How many steps to ask for (1-9).

refreshOnStart.title: Refresh on start
refreshOnStart.description: Ask for a fresh list when a session starts in a git repository, or when a session that started headless is first opened.

allowedTools.title: Tools the headless run may use
allowedTools.description: Comma-separated permission rules for the headless run; empty uses a built-in read-only set of git and gh read commands plus Read, Glob and Grep. The run gets only the tools these rules name, but your own user settings' allow rules for those tools apply too. git push, git config, git -c, gh api and --output are always denied.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model for the headless run (alias or id); empty uses your default.

primeCommand.title: Prime command
primeCommand.description: A slash command, with any arguments, that /clear + paste runs after the clear (such as /lril:prime). The step's prompt is filled once the turn it starts ends. Empty runs none.

modelChoice.title: System One models
modelChoice.description: Which System One model judges whether a turn finished the active step. Local only: Laya on this machine, or Haiku as before. Local first: Laya, and TypeSafe's hosted Jev while Laya is unavailable. Hosted first: Jev, and Laya while Jev is unavailable. Jev receives the active step's title, reason and prompt and the last 8,000 characters of Claude's answer, once after each answered turn while a step is active.

jevApiKey.title: Jev API key
jevApiKey.description: Your key for TypeSafe's hosted Jev, from console.typesafe.ai. Sent only to api.typesafe.ai, and only while System One models allows Jev. A changed key takes effect once the mod reloads.

layaPort.title: Laya port
layaPort.description: The port laya-serve listens on at 127.0.0.1 (its LAYA_PORT).
